selection_tradeoffs: The core is a technical source/ingestion fixture, not a nutritionally balanced weekly menu or a launch-size product catalogue. It spans egg and oat breakfasts, poultry and fish mains, soups, cooked vegetables, grains, salads, a condiment, fruit desserts and a smoothie.

Most qualified concepts have only one evidenced panel chain. They are deliberately RU_AVAILABLE, not claimed RU_MASS_MARKET; commodity three-chain positives are retained where verified. Family practicality is an equipment/preparation assessment, not tested taste, cost, health, storage or child-safety certification.

The original 119-code union is historical. Exact new union is mechanically derived from the selected rows; global183 catalogue remains unchanged. Unselected optional additions and source alternatives remain in the ingredient audit, not silently converted into required fixture ingredients.

Additional rejected candidates and failures (unquantified required seasoning, missing global codes, wrong-form foods, source retrieval/notice gaps) remain in candidate-review-v2 through v5. No rejected candidate is a production recipe.
